question: Which of the following states primarily celebrate the chhath puja festival in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chhath Puja:-**

 
 
• **It is primarily celebrated in the state of Bihar, which is located in the eastern part of India.**
 
• It is a four-day festival that is dedicated to the worship of the Sun God and his wife Usha.
 
• During this festival, devotees offer prayers to the Sun God and take a dip in holy rivers like the Ganges and the Yamuna.
 
• The festival is celebrated with great enthusiasm and devotion by people of all ages and backgrounds in Bihar. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajasthan:-**

 
 
• It is known for its colorful festivals like the Pushkar Camel Fair, the Jaipur Literature Festival, and the Teej festival.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat:-**
 
 
• It is famous for its Navratri festival, which is celebrated with traditional dance forms like Garba and Dandiya.
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh:-**
 
 
• It is known for its grand celebrations of the Telugu New Year festival called Ugadi.
